title: AetherDrop
description: AetherDrop is a powerful and fully customizable airdrop event plugin for Minecraft servers, designed to create exciting, reward-filled events where crates fall from the sky with stunning visual effects and valuable loot.
body:
![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d38f0c53cd62a1217f41e51953c94497eab1a84.png)

🌌 AETHERDROP

⚡ Advanced Airdrop Event Plugin for Minecraft ⚡

POWERFUL ✦ CUSTOMIZABLE ✦ IMMERSIVE

---

🎁 Overview

AetherDrop is a next-generation airdrop plugin that brings epic sky-drop events to your Minecraft server.

✨ Watch crates fall from the sky
🌈 Stunning beam & particle effects
⚡ Compete with players for powerful loot

🎯 Control everything. Customize everything. Engage every player.

---

✨ Features

🎁 Airdrop Tiers — 4+ tiers, unique loot, balanced rewards, fully customizable

🌈 Visual Effects — beams, animations, particles, lightning, sounds

📦 Crates — interactive system, states, despawn timer, optimized

🧭 Tracking — compass navigation, instant location, PvP fights

🧾 Holograms — floating text, dynamic placeholders, customizable

⚙️ Configuration — radius, height, timers, effects, loot chances

---

🎮 Commands

/airdrop spawn <level>
/airdrop start <level>
/airdrop stop
/airdrop reload
/airdrop give <player>

/airdrop
/airdrop locate
/airdrop info
---

🔑 Permissions

aetherdrop.admin
aetherdrop.use
---

📂 Loot System

/loots/level1.yml
/loots/level2.yml
/loots/level3.yml
/loots/level4.yml

✔ Add custom items
✔ Set drop chances
✔ Create rare rewards

---

🚀 Why AetherDrop?

✔ Highly customizable
✔ Beautiful visual effects
✔ Lightweight & optimized
✔ Perfect for PvP & Lifesteal
✔ Easy setup
✔ Professional quality
